description: This file implements TLS handling for gateway connections, including TLS configuration building, fingerprint probing, trust management, and fingerprint normalization. It provides secure communication setup via SSL/TLS protocols with optional pinning and verification mechanisms.

classes.name: GatewayTlsParams
classes.description: Data class representing TLS parameters including certificate fingerprint requirements, TOFU allowance, and a stable identifier.

classes.name: GatewayTlsConfig
classes.description: Data class encapsulating SSL socket factory, trust manager, and hostname verifier for TLS configuration.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeFailure
classes.description: Enum indicating the type of failure when probing a TLS fingerprint, either TLS_UNAVAILABLE or ENDPOINT_UNREACHABLE.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeResult
classes.description: Data class containing the result of a TLS fingerprint probe, including the fingerprint and failure reason if any.

methods.name: buildGatewayTlsConfig
methods.description: Constructs a TLS configuration object with custom trust management and hostname verification based on provided parameters.

methods.name: probeGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Performs a TLS handshake to retrieve and compute the SHA-256 fingerprint of a server's certificate, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: defaultTrustManager
methods.description: Provides the default X509TrustManager instance used for certificate validation.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Calculates the SHA-256 hex digest for a byte array.

methods.name: normalizeFingerprint
methods.description: Normalizes raw fingerprint strings by removing prefixes and non-hex characters, converting to lowercase.
